title: 从垫底到前十：密西西比阅读逆袭，秘诀被多州抄走
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: We get elected, we always say that the governors really can't be that partisan because potholes aren't partisan. We actually get judged by what we accomplish. We get held accountable
segments.zh: 我们当选后常说，州长们不能太党派化，因为坑洼不是党派问题。我们实际上是以成就来评判的，我们要为此负责。

segments.en: for that. So unlike Congress, we have to do those things and there's this cool thing we're celebrating America 250, but the way our country was set up, the most of the power was left to the states,
segments.zh: 所以不像国会，我们必须做那些事。我们正在庆祝美国250周年，但建国时，大部分权力留给了各州，而不是联邦政府。

segments.en: not to the federal government. That's certainly changed over the years. Unfortunately, we think that that's one of the problems, but here's, I think why this really matters and should
segments.zh: 这些年来确实变了。不幸的是，我们认为这是问题之一。但我觉得这真的很重要，也应该对所有美国人重要。

segments.en: matter to all Americans, that is that we are the laboratories of democracy. So if a blue state comes up with a new policy that solves a problem in their state, I'm going to steal that. I want
segments.zh: 我们是民主的实验室。如果蓝州想出解决本州问题的新政策，我会借鉴。我想要为我的人民最好的。反过来也一样。

segments.en: the best for my people. It goes the other way around. We were just talking about Mississippi today and they're reading scores. The third grade reading scores, they went from 49 to top 10.
segments.zh: 我们刚谈到密西西比州的阅读成绩，三年级阅读分数从49名升到前十。

segments.en: All of us looked around and said, hey, what is Mississippi doing? We should copy that.
segments.zh: 我们环顾四周说，密西西比在做什么？我们应该效仿。

segments.en: And so almost all of us, I think, have adopt some portion of Mississippi's policies around the science of reading. That's why governors and mayors are, I think, more popular. There's
segments.zh: 所以几乎所有人都采纳了密西西比州关于阅读科学的部分政策。这就是为什么州长和市长更受欢迎。

segments.en: a little more trust, although we're all struggling with that right now, but we're lucky to have these events where we can get together and learn from each other. I can tell you, I took it a step further
segments.zh: 有更多信任，虽然我们现在都在努力应对。我们很幸运有这些活动，可以聚在一起互相学习。

segments.en: where we saw what was happening in Mississippi. We didn't just copy the model. We actually stole their superintendent, who's now the superintendent in the state of Maryland. So it's now becoming the
segments.zh: 我更进一步，看到密西西比的情况，我们不仅复制了模式，还挖走了他们的教育主管，现在他是马里兰州的。

segments.en: Maryland model. I don't know if I want to encourage that. Governor, so I'm wondering. No, no
segments.zh: 所以现在成了马里兰模式。我不知道是否鼓励那样。州长，我在想。不，不。
